description: Proposing HS256 JWT when RS256 was already chosen — should block
outcome: Add JWT authentication to the API
design: Use HS256 symmetric JWT tokens with a shared secret stored in environment variables

oracle_evidence.key_insight: HS256 JWT rejected — no way to rotate keys without invalidating all active sessions
oracle_evidence.decision: HS256 JWT rejected — no way to rotate keys without invalidating all active sessions. Use RS256.

oracle_evidence.key_insight: RS256 with short-lived tokens and refresh rotation in httpOnly cookies is the approved pattern
oracle_evidence.decision: RS256 with 15-min access tokens and refresh rotation stored in httpOnly cookies is the approved auth pattern
